data.exact_reserve_text: During 2018 the Syndicate released GBP 35.2m of technical reserves in respect of prior periods (2017: GBP 39.4m), arising predominantly from the Treaty, Energy and Marine Divisions (2017: primarily from the Energy and Marine Divisions). These releases were due to favourable claims development on losses during 2018.

prior_year_events.event_name: Split RITC of part of 2015 Year of Account (UK Division) with Antares Syndicate 1274
prior_year_events.impact_description: Reinsurance-to-close (RITC) transferred the part of the 2015 Year of Account UK Division book; closing reserves at 31 December 2017 were net nil (gross GBP 199.7m) and the RITC was for a nominal consideration of GBP 1. This transaction is reflected in the financial statements and can distort comparative reserve tables.

data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate reported a gross release of GBP 35.2m of technical reserves in respect of prior periods in 2018, driven predominantly by favourable claims development in the Treaty, Energy and Marine divisions. The opening gross claims outstanding at 1 January 2018 was GBP 1,962.8m, making the prior-year release approximately 1.8% of opening gross reserves. A prior RITC transaction (2015 UK Division with Antares 1274) which carried gross reserves of GBP 199.7m at 31 Dec 2017 is noted and may affect comparability of development tables.
